name: Calvin Klein
note: Classic designer, modest scores: Calvin Klein averages 6.9 on Parfumo, and most scents here sit between 6.3 and 7.7. CK One has by far the most ratings (2,797) but only 6.8. The women's Obsession EDP (7.6) and Euphoria EDP (7.3) are the best-rated big names; on the men's side, CK One Shock for Him and Euphoria Men Intense lead. Parfumo's brand list didn't show scores, so these 19 come from the individual scent pages; a few popular ones without a readable photo (Euphoria Men, CK In2U for Him, Secret Obsession) are left out.
